description:
Public model×task-type leaderboard — the raw material for "best model for <task_type> under $X". Curated models ranked by the auto-eval success rate for the requested task_type (the shared prior), each row carrying the headline benchmark and the cheapest live blended price across providers.
Pass task_type to rank for a specific task (e.g. "coding", "planning"); omit for the global ranking. To answer a budget question, rank by task_type then filter rows by the blended price. Public — no brand data, not metered.

task_type.description: Rank for this task type (omit = global ranking).

name: gate_leaderboard
